# Bizgenix AI

> Bizgenix AI (Bizgenix AI Solutions Pvt Ltd) is an AI automation and AI development company based in Ahmedabad, Gujarat, India. It builds custom AI solutions and AI automation for Indian businesses, sells its own AI products, and delivers AI consulting and corporate AI training. It was founded by Dr. CA Umang Ratani.

## Company facts

- Legal name: Bizgenix AI Solutions Private Limited, Ahmedabad, Gujarat, India. Founded 2025 by Dr. CA Umang Ratani (Founder & CEO), with co-founders Hitesh Mehra and CA Archit Shah. Umang's consulting work dates from 2013; he began building AI automations for clients in 2023.
- Address: G-13, Silver Radiance-2, Science City Road, Sola, Ahmedabad 380060. Email info@bizgenix.ai. Phone/WhatsApp +91 87806 71906. Hours Mon–Fri 10:30–18:00.
- Founder page: https://bizgenix.ai/about/umang-ratani
- FAQ: https://bizgenix.ai/faq
- Pricing (ruled prices, before 18% GST): https://bizgenix.ai/pricing
- AI agent development: https://bizgenix.ai/ai-agent-development
- Free tool for Tally users: "Where is my money stuck?" working-capital calculator (debtor, stock and creditor days, cash cycle, money locked up; runs in the browser): https://bizgenix.ai/tools/where-is-my-money-stuck

## People

- Founder: Dr. CA Umang Ratani, AI and business consultant, Chartered Accountant, TEDx speaker, and lead trainer of Scale With AI. Has trained 2,000+ business owners on AI and 20,000+ professionals across his career; addressed 800+ professionals at CMAI Mumbai (3 Jun 2026) and spoke at the AI Summit, Gurugram (Sep 2026). https://www.umangratani.com/

## Services

- [AI automation](https://bizgenix.ai/ai-automation): WhatsApp workflows, reminders, document checking, email triage, sales call analysis and reporting, built on the tools a business already uses.
- [AI consulting](https://bizgenix.ai/ai-consulting): use-case assessment, data readiness and a 90-day implementation plan with pass/fail gates, for owner-led businesses.
- [Custom AI solutions](https://bizgenix.ai/custom-solutions): AI applications, AI CRM, AI ERP, web and mobile platforms, business intelligence and system integrations.
- [Corporate AI training](https://bizgenix.ai/corporate-ai-training): hands-on AI workshops for leadership and departments. [Scale With AI](https://bizgenix.ai/scale-with-ai): one-day AI workshops and the recorded AI course for business owners. [All courses](https://bizgenix.ai/courses).

## Products

- [Growth Intelligence](https://bizgenix.ai/products/growth-intelligence): an AI Chief Value Officer for businesses on Tally. Reads Tally read-only, recomputes fourteen measures across cash, margin, stock, growth and risk, prepares three decisions a week and follows through on your approval. App: https://gi.bizgenix.ai/
- [Bizgenix AI CRM](https://bizgenix.ai/products/ai-crm): captures leads from IndiaMART, Justdial, Facebook and Instagram ads and email, scores and assigns them, and keeps follow-ups, WhatsApp conversations, invoices and agreements in one workspace. App: https://crm.bizgenix.ai/
- [Voice AI](https://bizgenix.ai/products/voice-ai): inbound and outbound AI calling in English, Hindi and Hinglish for lead qualification, bookings, reminders and follow-up, with outcomes written to the CRM.
- [BizChat](https://bizgenix.ai/products/bizchat): WhatsApp automation for lead replies, follow-ups, reminders, support and broadcasts, connected to CRM and spreadsheets.
- [ScaleOS](https://bizgenix.ai/products/scaleos): tasks, processes, approvals and management reports in one system, with WhatsApp notifications.
- [All products](https://bizgenix.ai/products)

## Playbooks

Free, open guides with ready-to-paste prompts and templates, by Dr. CA Umang Ratani and the Bizgenix AI team. These are the guides sent to people who ask for them on Umang's Instagram reels.

- [All playbooks](https://bizgenix.ai/playbooks)
- [handoff.md template: continue a long Claude session in a new chat](https://bizgenix.ai/playbooks/handoff-md-template-for-long-claude-sessions): Ask the assistant to write a handoff file before you stop, then upload that file to a fresh chat. A good handoff lists the goal, what is done, what failed, the constraints and the next steps, so the new session does not repeat old mistakes.
- [The LLM Council prompt: five expert views before one answer](https://bizgenix.ai/playbooks/llm-council-prompt): Ask the assistant to act as a council: five advisors with different jobs (contrarian, first principles, expansionist, outsider, executor) analyse the problem, then a chairman settles their disagreements and gives one recommendation. The full prompt is below.
- [Business card to CRM: 10 AI prompts for event follow-up](https://bizgenix.ai/playbooks/business-card-to-crm-prompts): Photograph each card and ask an AI assistant to extract the details as structured data, then clean them into a sheet, score the leads and draft a personal follow-up for each. The ten prompts below cover every step.
- [AI image upscale prompt that does not change the face](https://bizgenix.ai/playbooks/ai-image-upscale-prompt-without-changing-face): Use a prompt that first lists what must stay identical (identity, facial proportions, expression, clothing, background and framing) and only then asks for sharper detail, better lighting and more depth. The full prompt is below.
- [Business Brain: use Claude Code and Obsidian as your company memory](https://bizgenix.ai/playbooks/business-brain-claude-code-obsidian): Keep your SOPs, client notes, meeting notes and research as files in an Obsidian vault and open that folder in Claude Code. The assistant can then search, summarise and advise from your own material; the ten steps and prompts are below.
- [How to make a product video ad with ChatGPT and Google Flow](https://bizgenix.ai/playbooks/ai-product-video-ad-chatgpt-google-flow): Upload a clean product photo to ChatGPT and ask it to write a cinematic video prompt, then paste that prompt into Google Flow with the photo as the reference image. Generate several versions in 9:16 and keep the one where the product is shown accurately.
- [100 ChatGPT prompt shortcuts (and how to make them work)](https://bizgenix.ai/playbooks/chatgpt-prompt-shortcuts): No. ChatGPT has no hidden commands of that kind. They are short names for instructions, and they work once you paste the instruction or save the list in Custom Instructions; the 100 shortcuts and their instructions are below.
- [73 Claude prompt shortcuts (and the exact instruction behind each)](https://bizgenix.ai/playbooks/claude-prompt-shortcuts): No. Claude has no hidden commands or secret modes. Each shortcut is a short label for a concrete instruction you save in a Claude Project or paste at the start of your prompt; all 73 shortcuts and their full instructions are below.

## Videos

Dr. CA Umang Ratani teaches AI for business on video in Hindi and Hinglish. Each page below has a written English summary, key points and chapters of one video.

- [Video library](https://bizgenix.ai/videos): all videos by topic, with the YouTube channel (https://www.youtube.com/@umangratani).
- [What is AI? A plain introduction for business owners](https://bizgenix.ai/videos/what-is-artificial-intelligence-for-business-owners): In simple words, AI is a smart assistant that can do much of the work you now do yourself. Umang says most people hand it only small jobs such as email replies, although it can do far more, so what matters is how you use it.
- [How to write better AI prompts: role, outcome, context](https://bizgenix.ai/videos/how-to-write-better-ai-prompts): Give the AI clear instructions: tell it what role to play, say exactly what outcome you want, and share context about you and your business. Umang says weak results usually come from a vague request, not from the AI tool, so better instructions bring better output.
- [RACE framework and meta prompting for better AI results](https://bizgenix.ai/videos/context-engineering-race-framework): Structure your prompt with the four-part RACE framework: role, action, context and expectation. Better still, ask the AI itself to write the detailed prompt for you, review it, and then use that prompt to get the final work done.
- [Prompt engineering basics: the RTCCF framework in Hindi](https://bizgenix.ai/videos/ai-prompting-explained-in-hindi): Give the AI clear instructions, the way you would brief a new employee. Umang's five-part RTCCF framework says to state the Role, the Task, the Context, the Constraints and the Format, and to be clear about the output you want before you type anything.
- [How to use meta prompting to make AI write your prompts](https://bizgenix.ai/videos/prompting-method-for-business-owners): Ask the AI to write the prompt for you, a method called meta prompting, then copy that prompt back in to do the actual task. Umang also shows the screenshot technique: upload a screenshot of work you like and ask the AI to draft the prompt behind it.
- [How to set custom instructions and privacy in ChatGPT](https://bizgenix.ai/videos/chatgpt-custom-instructions-and-ai-data-privacy): Open Settings, go to Personalization and fill in Custom Instructions with who you are and how you work, so you need not repeat it each time. For privacy, Umang says the tools let you choose in their privacy settings whether your chats are used to improve the model.
- [What is agentic AI? Gemini demo with Calendar and Gmail](https://bizgenix.ai/videos/agentic-ai-gemini-gmail-calendar-drive): Generative AI creates text, images or video, while agentic AI carries out the task for you, like an employee. Umang shows this in Gemini, where typing @ connects Google apps, so a single instruction schedules a meeting in Google Calendar.
- [Why AI gives fake answers and how NotebookLM helps](https://bizgenix.ai/videos/chatgpt-hallucination-and-notebooklm): AI can invent facts, such as court cases that do not exist, and it loses track when you give it very long documents, so always verify its output. Umang recommends Google NotebookLM, which answers by reading the documents or links you add as sources.
- [What Claude Cowork is and what it can do on your computer](https://bizgenix.ai/videos/claude-cowork-explained): Claude Cowork is a feature from Anthropic that lets non-technical users give Claude an instruction and have it work on files and folders on their computer, like an agent. Examples in the video include summarising documents and podcast files, making notes and organising a cluttered desktop.
- [What ChatGPT Operator is: a live demo for business research](https://bizgenix.ai/videos/chatgpt-operator-demo): ChatGPT Operator is an AI agent that opens its own web browser and completes a task step by step, instead of only replying with text. In the demo, Umang uploads a file and asks for market research for a visa consulting business, and Operator visits several websites and returns suggestions.
- [How ChatGPT Deep Research helps with business research](https://bizgenix.ai/videos/deep-research-for-business-research): Deep Research is a ChatGPT feature that searches many internet sources, combines the findings and gives you a ready report with conclusions. Umang says business owners can use it for competitor, pricing and strategy analysis, and then take decisions based on that research.
- [How small businesses can use AI every day: ReTechCon talk](https://bizgenix.ai/videos/how-small-businesses-can-use-ai-every-day-retechcon-2026): Start with the work you repeat every day: replying to customer emails, writing product content, researching, summarising and chasing payments. Give the AI tool your business context and a clear prompt, because the tool alone is not the advantage; how you use it is.
- [From traditional business to AI-powered business: CMAI talk](https://bizgenix.ai/videos/traditional-business-to-ai-powered-business-cmai-talk): Begin with AI for everyday productivity, then choose the tools that fit your work, and only then add AI agents and automation to scale. Umang walks a hall of business owners through that order with live examples in this full CMAI session.
- [AI roadmap for business owners: interview with Viral Sakhiya](https://bizgenix.ai/videos/ai-roadmap-for-business-owners-interview): Start with one general AI assistant and learn to prompt it well, then add business context, and then move to AI agents and automation department by department. In this interview Umang lays out that roadmap across eight departments of a business.
- [What a Virtual CEO is and how it helps MSME owners](https://bizgenix.ai/videos/virtual-ceo-program-explained): A Virtual CEO is an outside expert team that works like a part-time CEO for a business that cannot afford a full-time one. Umang says most coaches and consultants only advise, while his team also supports execution in hiring, sales and marketing.
